brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered a "full lockdown" of the occupied West Bank in response to a shooting incident, Al Jazeera English reported. The lockdown measure represents a significant security response, though details about the shooting itself were not immediately available.

The extent and duration of the lockdown, along with its specific restrictions on movement and access, were not specified in the initial announcement. Netanyahu's order follows a pattern of heightened security measures implemented during periods of violence in the territory.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu orders a “full lockdown” of the occupied West Bank following a shooting.
title: Netanyahu orders full lockdown of occupied West Bank after shooting
